sentences.text: A derivor from Sigma to Lambda sends every sort to a sort, and every operation symbol to a term of the matching sort, in variables of the matching sorts.
For instance, a derivor from Sigma to itself may send sigma to the term sigma of v zero and tau of v zero, where v zero is a variable of sort s.
A derivor induces a functor in the opposite direction, from Lambda-algebras to Sigma-algebras.
It takes a Lambda-algebra, uses its carrier of the image sort as the carrier of each sort, and interprets each symbol as its term.
The translation goes from Sigma to Lambda, so the algebras go from Lambda back to Sigma.
